subject.title: fix: enforce sandbox tool policy for loopback tools [AI]

question: Should gateway loopback/MCP tools now fail closed under `tools.sandbox.tools.*` for sandboxed sessions with the posted production-adapter proof, or should merge wait for stronger harness proof or adjacent resolver work?
rationale: The patch matches the documented sandbox tool-policy boundary, but it intentionally changes the effective tool surface for existing sandboxed loopback clients and carries a protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Accept fail-closed hardening
options.body: Land after maintainer confirmation that sandboxed loopback/MCP sessions should lose tools denied by sandbox policy and ordinary merge checks are green.

options.title: Require full harness proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted external coding-agent CLI/container loopback run if production-adapter JSON-RPC proof is not enough for this boundary.

options.title: Wait for adjacent resolver work
options.body: Pause until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102003 is resolved, then rebase and verify sandbox filtering plus plugin-tool visibility together.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed hardening
recommendation.body: Land after maintainer confirmation that sandboxed loopback/MCP sessions should lose tools denied by sandbox policy and ordinary merge checks are green.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to both the original loopback bridge and recent loopback resolver capability work, making it the strongest available owner signal for the boundary decision.
